verified_title: System One Models for Wireless Decision-Making:Applications and Performance Evaluation
metadata_description: Abstract page for arXiv paper 2610.04345: System One Models for Wireless Decision-Making:Applications and Performance Evaluation
method_summary: A system-one model answers a query with probabilities over admissible finite decisions instead of free text. Proper scoring, calibration, receive-antenna selection, slicing and edge decisions are discussed alongside state/history, hysteresis, safety shielding and fallback.
direct_overlap: typed decision probabilities instead of generated text
evidence_and_limits: Wireless task examples do not validate arbitrary protocol support or autonomous warehouse hardware deployment. A normalized output distribution alone is not a calibration certificate.
